/// Every language in <c>[assembly: SupportedLanguages]</c> has a set that implements it next to <see cref="CodeChops.Idioma.ILocalizationSet"/>, named with its language as suffix.
/// A language without a set, or a set without a text, is a build error rather than a fallback at run time.

    /// <remarks>
    /// Wording:
    /// <list type="bullet">
    /// <item><description><see cref="ShopLocalizationEn.Greeting">en</see>: Hello, {name}!</description></item>
    /// <item><description><see cref="ShopLocalizationNl.Greeting">nl</see>: Hallo, {name}!</description></item>
    /// </list>
    /// </remarks>
    [CodeChops.Idioma.Internals.ShownValue("name")]

    /// </summary>
    /// <remarks>
